summary: The team reviewed beta-launch readiness. The launch was moved from Thursday to Tuesday July 28 because the login timeout fix lands Friday, and the beta will be invite-only for its first two weeks.

decisions.text: Move the beta launch to Tuesday, July 28.
decisions.context: So we've decided to move the beta launch to next Tuesday, the 28th.

decisions.text: Keep the beta invite-only for the first two weeks.
decisions.context: we agreed to keep the beta invite-only for the first two weeks, right? No open signups until we see how the servers hold up.
